scene: The mechanical board clatters, revealing three strange departures across the city.
picture: Flat side view along the polished marble concourse floor. On the far left, a boy with curly dark hair, glasses, denim jacket, and camera stands looking upward. To his left stands a heavy iron freight lift. In the centre waits a glowing blue tram. On the right, a brass service elevator awaits.
shown: a heavy iron freight lift with rattling metal gate open on the left
a glowing blue night tram waiting with doors open in the centre
a gleaming brass service elevator with lighted call button on the right
